reviews.t: Great product for any skin type.
reviews.x: I have used this product for many years after my dermatologist recommended it for daily cleansing. He said this is better than any high-priced product for cleansing on a daily basis and I agree. My skin feels refreshed, any blemishes have gone by the wayside, and it doesn't make my skin dry or flaky. I use it once a day at night before bed along with a fresh washcloth to wash my face (yes, I have a drawerful of white washcloths for this very reason) and have not had any issues in years.

I’ve been using this for years and it’s so hard to find in stores. I’m not sure if they discontinued it or not, but this is the best stuff for my face. The bottles came wrapped in plastic and there were no spills like others said, so I’m glad it worked out well.

reviews.t: Great mild soap for sensitive skin.
reviews.x: This mild soap is for sensitive skin. I have used it for years due to having a very crazy kind of skin. Oily, break outs, dry in spots, just a little of everything but this has been the best soap for it.  I love it!!!! VERY MILD.

I hope they never quit making Purpose wash. It's gentle and doesn't burn eyes or irritate sensitive skin. Just a simple, good quality cleanser that's oil-free and noncomedogenic. I've used it for years and love it.

I have used this product for more than 10 years, daily!  This cleanser works really good for me because I have sensitive skin and many face products will clog my pores.  I cannot even wash my face with soap!  This cleanser leaves my face nice and clean and the larger pores of my skin appear smaller. I also started breaking out, and this is the only change that I made. If you buy this in store, I fully support it, but I wouldn’t purchase this again online.

claims.text: Reviewers widely praise this cleanser as gentle and effective for sensitive skin, noting it doesn't dry, burn, or irritate.
Many reviewers have used this product for years, often after a dermatologist recommendation, and consider it a long-term staple.
Several reviewers note the product is hard to find in stores and are glad to find it online.
Some reviewers report packaging problems, including leaks and spills during shipment.
A few reviewers raise concerns about price increases or the online product differing from what they bought in stores.
